resolved_findings.D1: Fixed complete six-fact contract anchored in reviewed source FIXED_ROWS; jointly changed input/submission rejected.
resolved_findings.D2: Regular file, final symlink and special-file checks; O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK plus inode/device race check; FIFO rejected promptly.
resolved_findings.D3: ValueError/RecursionError produce invalid-input exit2; malformed encoding/json and numeric limits tested.
resolved_findings.D4: README explicitly separates synthetic review tests from manual user review; check-golden only good/bad; no automatic approve generation.

limitations: Only Linux Python3.12 actually exercised; Python3.10+ and other POSIX environments not runtime-certified; missing safe-open flags fail closed.
Upper directory and reviewed source must be trusted; not a malicious-filesystem sandbox.
Hashes bind bytes, not identity/signature; HUMAN-DEMO is not authenticated reviewer identity.
Synthetic approve/reject state tests are not real human approval and grant no dispatch authority.
Original design review retained as historical finding; final README/CHANGELOG describe resolved implementation.
No network/product/model/SDK execution, credentials, Mac operation, canonical integration, push or deployment.
report_scope: Original offline rule simulation only; not LLM semantic extraction/MCP compliance/product effectiveness or production authorization proof.
